title: Adaptive Experimentation Can Hide Model Error:Detection Limits and Falsification Budget
abstract: arXiv:2611.07529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An experiment can be informative about the parameters of a working model and uninformative about whether that model is wrong. Adaptive design can reinforce this mismatch by repeatedly selecting settings where an incorrect model fits. We bound the power of any valid adequacy test in terms of the experimenter's own sampling distribution, then distinguish information absent from the selected data from information lost by the detector. A computable diagnostic measures unresolved error relative to a declared expansion of the working model. It motivates a training-free rule that reserves part of the design budget for falsification. The empirical record is mixed: the independently specified primary study fails detection eligibility, and a later numerator diagnostic fails its improvement criteria. After the frozen rule fails on fresh continuous-null panels, a disclosed secondary horizon-calibrated revision detects 35.8% of misspecified campaig

translated_title: 自适应实验可能掩盖模型误差：检测极限与证伪预算
translated_abstract: 一个实验可能对工作模型的参数提供有效信息，却对模型本身是否错误不提供任何信息。自适应设计会通过反复选择错误模型恰好能够拟合的实验设置，从而加剧这种不匹配。我们利用实验者自身的抽样分布，为任何有效的充分性检验的功效设定了上界，并进一步区分了所选数据中缺失的信息与检测器本身损失的信息。我们提出了一个可计算的诊断指标，用以相对于所声明的工作模型扩展来度量尚未解决的模型误差。这一指标促成了一个无需训练的规则，即为证伪保留一部分设计预算。实证结果好坏参半：独立设定的主研究未通过检测资格验证，随后的分子诊断也未能达到其改进标准。在冻结规则于新的连续零假设面板上失败后，一个公开的、经过地平线校准的次要修订版检测到了35.8%的错误设定实验（注：摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文证明了自适应实验设计可能通过选择错误模型恰好拟合的设置来掩盖模型误差，提出了检验功效上界、可计算的诊断指标以及无需训练的证伪预算规则，主张在实验设计中主动为证伪模型保留部分预算。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that adaptive experimental design can hide model error by repeatedly selecting settings where a wrong model fits, and proposes power bounds for adequacy tests, a computable diagnostic, and a training-free falsification budget rule that reserves part of the design budget for falsification.
